question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Credeble"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Credible"**. (विश्वसनीय)

 

 
• **Meaning:** Something that is believable or convincing.

 
• **Hindi meaning:** विश्वसनीय

 
• **Example:** The journalist presented credible evidence to support her claims.

 

 

 
• **Correct word:** Credible (विश्वसनीय)

 

 
• **Hindi meaning:** विश्वसनीय

 
• **Example:** The teacher appreciated the credible explanation given by the student.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Devoted** (समर्पित): Very loyal or loving.

 

 
• **Example:** She is devoted to her family and spends quality time with them every day.

 

 

 
• **Explosive** (विस्फोटक): Something that is capable of causing an explosion or a sudden outburst.

 

 
• **Example:** The situation became explosive after the heated argument between the two groups.

 

 

 
• **Creative** (रचनात्मक): Using imagination or original ideas to create something.

 

 
• **Example:** The artist’s creative work impressed everyone at the exhibition.
